entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, the leader in personal fitness technology. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Billing' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of garbage.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a personal preference issue?
It's a fault. The heart rate is all over the place. Look, I don't have time to play 20 questions. I just want my money back.

I understand your frustration. For a reported defect, the first step is to connect you with our technical support team to troubleshoot and verify the issue. They can often resolve it right over the phone.

Absolutely not. I don't have time for that. I've tried everything. I'm a VIP member and I'm not going to waste an hour on the phone for you to tell me to turn it off and on again. Just process the refund.
My apologies. Let me pull up your account details and review the options. Can you confirm the full name on the account?
Thank you, Mr. Chen. I see your account and your VIP status here. Thank you for your loyalty. One moment while I check the purchase date... Okay, I see you received it 40 days ago.

Well, good news. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. Given your status with us, I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Okay, finally. So what happens now?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label to send the band back to us. Once our warehouse scans it in, the refund will be credited to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
Excellent. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mr. Chen?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
